name: Mail
description: Reads up to three mailboxes over IMAP, read-only, and sends new mail and your replies to triage.

settings.label: Mail 1: name
settings.help: Shown on cards from this mailbox.

settings.label: Mail 1: IMAP server
settings.help: Port 993 with TLS. Add :port for another one. Empty turns this mailbox off.

settings.label: Mail 1: password
settings.help: For Gmail, an app password (Google Account > Security > App passwords), not your normal one.
